working_title: Cache, Adapt, or Recompute? Budgeted Post-Training of Earth Embedding Products under Geographic Shift
primary_question: With K target support labels, can a low-rank spatial residual adapt a frozen OlmoEarth embedding cache better than head-only adaptation without raw input reads or cache invalidation?

existing_evidence_not_reestimated.closed_branch: MS-90B/MS-91/MS-92 P2/P4 prediction fusion and GeoContextGate; do not rename as MoE

development_regions.selection_rule: Use these already exposed regions only if a label-blind CPU audit confirms enough spatially disjoint events/components for every K. If either fails, replace it before any model result is read and seal the reason and manifest.

target_support.split: event_or_connected_component_grouped spatial blocks with a predeclared buffer
target_support.source_supervision_for_pt1: full source training data and source-selected source decoder checkpoint

A2_cachetune_strict.trainable: rank-16 low-rank spatial cache adapter plus scalar calibration
A2_cachetune_strict.initialization: U is zero-initialized so step-0 predictions equal A0

A2_nospatial_control.trainable: parameter-matched V-GELU-U residual plus scalar calibration

A2_joint_sensitivity.reason: Joint adaptation can be absorbed by the existing 1x1 768-to-128 decoder projection.

A3_encoder_peft_later.trainable: rslearn APLA or audited LoRA in OlmoEarth encoder

adapter.layer_norm: per cached channel; affine policy must be frozen before implementation
adapter.forbidden: Do not call this encoder LoRA and do not train the source decoder in the strict primary arm.

pt0_cpu_gates: Build and seal target support/query manifests without reading model metrics.
Verify event/component grouping, spatial buffer, no sample overlap, and K feasibility.
Implement adaptation in a new runner; do not modify protected confirmatory execution paths during an active run.
Verify checkpoint initialization and freeze policies with trainable-parameter snapshots.
Verify pos_weight, normalization, and loader exposure use only the declared data contract.
Verify A2 zero initialization reproduces A0 logits within a predeclared numeric tolerance.
Seal code snapshot, cache checksum, source checkpoint, support IDs, and fixed update count before GPU.

pt1_run_count.formula: 2 exposed regions x 2 K values x 3 trained arms (A1, A2-strict, A2-nospatial) x 3 support/optimizer pairs
pt1_run_count.a0: reused fixed checkpoint predictions; no target training

primary_evaluation.metric: positive-tile macro IoU at a source-development-selected operating point under the registered empty-tile FP rule
primary_evaluation.statistical_unit: geographic region; support and optimizer runs are repeated measurements, not independent regions

pass_if_either: A2-strict minus A1 is at least +0.01 primary IoU and has the same direction in both exposed regions.
A2-strict is within -0.01 of A1 while using at least 5x fewer trainable parameters.
method_gate.strong_evidence: At least +0.02 label-learning-curve area or at least 50 percent fewer target labels for matched performance.
method_gate.fail: If only A2-joint improves, demote the result to decoder adaptation; if A2-strict fails both pass conditions, do not open encoder PEFT, MoE, or the full method matrix.

systems_gate_after_a3.condition: Only defined if A3 minus A1 is positive.
systems_gate_after_a3.resource_ratio: A2 raw bytes plus encoder GPU time at most 0.10 of A3

moe_promotion.experts: small region/task cache adapters, never P2/P4 prediction experts
moe_promotion.router_unit: region or support set, not pixel or tile winner prediction
moe_promotion.open_only_if: FP-matched adapter oracle exceeds one shared adapter by at least +0.02 in at least three development regions or two tasks with consistent seeds.

action_planner.first_version: deterministic Pareto selector, not a learned router
inputs: GPU, latency, storage, and risk budget
action_planner.learned_promotion: Open a ranker or contextual bandit only after reproducible action crossovers exist and the deterministic policy has material oracle regret. PPO or multi-step RL is out of scope without cache-age trajectories.

active_support_optional.proposal: Spatially separated target support selection using Olmo embedding diversity plus source-head uncertainty.
active_support_optional.promotion: At least 20 percent fewer labels for matched performance or at least +0.02 learning-curve area, without worse worst-region performance beyond 0.01.
active_support_optional.forbidden: Do not use the final query block, target labels, or multiple patches from one event as independent acquisition rewards.

execution_order: Keep the raw recipe audit for the A4 baseline.
Complete PT-0 CPU manifest and runner invariants.
Run the 36-run PT-1 exposed-region screen on GPU1 only.
If PT-1 passes, add the A3 encoder-PEFT ceiling at K=20.
Freeze the method and run a new-method preregistered Sen12 matrix.
Open Korea once for spatially disjoint external few-shot and three-task cache amortization.
Open MoE, active acquisition, or bandit stages only after their oracle headroom gates pass.

relation_to_source_label_curve.scientific_role: necessary source-supervision baseline, not the method novelty
relation_to_source_label_curve.queue: do not use the first 144 runs as a paper conclusion; decide full 432-run execution after PT-1 viability and raw recipe audit without changing sealed IDs

external_roles.korea: final spatially disjoint target few-shot plus shared-cache land-cover, deforestation, and landslide system test
external_roles.nepal: K=0 operational embedding-delta case study only
external_roles.switzerland: later missing-band and sensor-contract stress; not equivalent transfer

forbidden_claims: Generic LoRA or MoE is novel.
A2-joint improvement proves cache-space representation adaptation.
Sen12 new-method evaluation is an untouched dataset.
Korea is used for both method selection and final external testing.
Trainable parameter count alone proves lower operational cost.

pt1_result_2026_09_02.fail_action_applied: encoder PEFT, MoE, full method matrix not opened; CacheTune reported as negative/analysis only
pt1_result_2026_09_02.positive_side_result: A1 decoder-only adaptation with K=5 tiles beats A0 by +0.080 (china) / +0.068 (chimanimani) FP-matched IoU while keeping the cache valid
pt1_result_2026_09_02.next_registered_question: A1 vs A4 raw few-shot vs A3 encoder PEFT at matched K (not yet run)
